a2-u9.titleEn.en: The zoo, the circus and a romantic dinner
a2-u9.titleEn.t: Hayvonot bogʻi, sirk va romantik kechki ovqat

en: Animal nouns: singular like people, plural like things
t: Hayvon nomlari: birlikda odamlar kabi, koʻplikda narsalar kabi

a2-u9-l1.milovat.note.en: It goes like študovať: **milujem**, miluješ, miluje… Sarah miluje zvieratá. = Sarah loves animals.
a2-u9-l1.milovat.note.t: študovať kabi tuslanadi: **milujem**, miluješ, miluje… Sarah miluje zvieratá. = Sara hayvonlarni yaxshi koʻradi.

a2-u9-l1.choice-liam-a-sarah.question.en: Emma's brother Liam (15) and her sister Sarah (11) live in Dublin. What does this mean?
a2-u9-l1.choice-liam-a-sarah.question.t: Emmaning ukasi Liam (15 yosh) va singlisi Sara (11 yosh) Dublinda yashaydi. Bu nimani anglatadi?

en: Liam and Sarah are going home.
Liam and Sarah have got visitors.
Liam and Sarah are coming to visit.
Sarah is eleven and loves animals.
Sarah is eleven and has a lot of animals.
Sarah is fifteen and loves animals.
t: Sara oʻn bir yoshda va hayvonlarni yaxshi koʻradi.
Sara oʻn bir yoshda va uning hayvonlari koʻp.
Sara oʻn besh yoshda va hayvonlarni yaxshi koʻradi.

a2-u9-l1.fill-liam-a-sarah-miluju.en.t: Liam va Sara hayvonlarni yaxshi koʻradi.

a2-u9-l1.fill-liam-a-sarah-miluju.why.en: Liam a Sarah are two people, oni, so the verb ends in **-ú**: miluj**ú**, like študujú.
a2-u9-l1.fill-liam-a-sarah-miluju.why.t: Liam a Sarah — ikki kishi, yaʼni oni, shuning uchun feʼl **-ú** bilan tugaydi: miluj**ú**, študujú kabi.

a2-u9-l1.build-zajtra-ideme-do.prompt.en: We're going to the zoo tomorrow.

en: Going into a place like the zoo takes **do**: do zoo, like do kina.
“We” is my, so **ideme**. Idú is oni.
t: Hayvonot bogʻi kabi joyning ichiga borilganda **do** ishlatiladi: do zoo, do kina kabi.
«Biz» — my, shuning uchun **ideme**. Idú — oni shakli.

en: The dog is what Sarah wants, the object. A dog is alive, so it adds **-a**, like brat → brata: **psa**.
Sarah is ona, so **chce**. Chcem is ja.
t: It — Sara xohlagan narsa, yaʼni toʻldiruvchi. It jonli mavjudot, shuning uchun odam kabi **-a** oladi, brat → brata kabi: **psa** (pes oʻzidagi e ni tushiradi).
Sara — ona, shuning uchun **chce**. Chcem — ja shakli.

a2-u9-l1.na-vlastne-oci.note.en: Chcem to vidieť **na vlastné oči**. = I want to see it with my own eyes. (oči = eyes)
a2-u9-l1.na-vlastne-oci.note.t: Chcem to vidieť **na vlastné oči**. = Buni oʻz koʻzim bilan koʻrmoqchiman. (oči = koʻzlar)

a2-u9-l1.fill-sarah-chce-vidiet.en.en: Sarah wants to see the animals with her own eyes.
a2-u9-l1.fill-sarah-chce-vidiet.en.t: Sara hayvonlarni oʻz koʻzi bilan koʻrmoqchi.

a2-u9-l1.fill-sarah-chce-vidiet.why.en: Oči (eyes) is plural, so the adjective ends in **-é**: vlastn**é** oči, like tie nové mosty.
a2-u9-l1.fill-sarah-chce-vidiet.why.t: Oči (koʻzlar) — koʻplik, shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi: vlastn**é** oči, tie nové mosty kabi.

a2-u9-l1.choice-uz-sa-neviem.question.en: It's the evening before the zoo. What does Sarah say?
a2-u9-l1.choice-uz-sa-neviem.question.t: Hayvonot bogʻiga borishdan oldingi oqshom. Sara nima deydi?

a2-u9-l1.fill-brat-a-sestra.en.en: My brother and sister are coming to visit.

a2-u9-l1.fill-brat-a-sestra.why.en: Here na answers “where to?”, so it takes the object form: -a → **-u**, na návštev**u**.
a2-u9-l1.fill-brat-a-sestra.why.t: Bu yerda na «qayerga?» savoliga javob beradi, shuning uchun toʻldiruvchi shakli keladi: -a → **-u**, na návštev**u** (mehmonga).

a2-u9-l2.lev.note.en: As an object, a lion adds -a, like a person: Vidím **leva**. = I can see a lion.
a2-u9-l2.lev.note.t: Toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda sher ham odam kabi -a oladi: Vidím **leva**. = Sherni koʻryapman.

a2-u9-l2.tiger.note.en: The e drops before an ending: Vidím **tigra**.
a2-u9-l2.tiger.note.t: Qoʻshimcha qoʻshilganda e tushib qoladi: Vidím **tigra**. = Yoʻlbarsni koʻryapman.

a2-u9-l2.choice-chcem-vidiet-leva.questi.en: Sarah wants to see a lion. What does she say?
a2-u9-l2.choice-chcem-vidiet-leva.questi.t: Sara sherni koʻrmoqchi. U nima deydi?

a2-u9-l2.choice-chcem-vidiet-leva.why.en: A lion is alive, so as the object it adds **-a**, like brat → brata: vidieť **leva**. Tigra is a tiger.
a2-u9-l2.choice-chcem-vidiet-leva.why.t: Sher jonli mavjudot, shuning uchun toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda **-a** oladi, brat → brata kabi: vidieť **leva**. Tigra — yoʻlbars.

a2-u9-l2.slon.note.en: Slon je veľký. Vidíš **slona**? = Can you see the elephant?
a2-u9-l2.slon.note.t: Slon je veľký. = Fil katta. Vidíš **slona**? = Filni koʻryapsanmi?

a2-u9-l2.opica.note.t: káva kabi oʻzgaradi: Vidím **opicu**. = Maymunni koʻryapman.

a2-u9-l2.fill-sarah-vidi-slona.why.en: One elephant as the object: animals add **-a**, like people, so vidí **slona**.
a2-u9-l2.fill-sarah-vidi-slona.why.t: Bitta fil toʻldiruvchi boʻlib kelgan: hayvonlar odamlar kabi **-a** oladi, shuning uchun vidí **slona**.

a2-u9-l2.ktore-zviera-mas.en.en: Which animal do you like best?

a2-u9-l2.ktore-zviera-mas.note.en: **najradšej** = best of all. Najradšej mám opice. = I like monkeys best.
a2-u9-l2.ktore-zviera-mas.note.t: **najradšej** = hammadan koʻra, eng koʻp. Najradšej mám opice. = Hammadan koʻra maymunlarni yaxshi koʻraman.

a2-u9-l2.choice-najradsej-mam-zirafy.que.en: Liam answers. Which animals does he like best?
a2-u9-l2.choice-najradsej-mam-zirafy.que.t: Liam javob beradi. U qaysi hayvonlarni hammadan yaxshi koʻradi?

a2-u9-l2.build-ktore-zviera-mas.prompt.en: Which animal do you like best, Sarah?
a2-u9-l2.build-ktore-zviera-mas.prompt.t: Qaysi hayvonni hammadan yaxshi koʻrasan, Sara?

en: Zviera is neuter, so “which” is **ktoré**, like ktoré okno.
Emma says ty to her little sister: **máš**.
t: Zviera — oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun «qaysi» **ktoré** boʻladi, ktoré okno kabi.

a2-u9-l2.fill-najradsej-mam-opice.why.en: Monkeys in general means the plural, opica → **opice**, like rieka → rieky. As an object, it doesn't change.
a2-u9-l2.fill-najradsej-mam-opice.why.t: Umuman maymunlar haqida gap ketganda koʻplik keladi: opica → **opice**, rieka → rieky kabi. Toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda bu shakl oʻzgarmaydi. (Oʻzbekchada «maymunni yaxshi koʻraman» deyish mumkin, slovakchada esa koʻplik kerak.)

en: The bear is big and strong.
The giraffe is big and the elephant is tall.
The monkey is tall and the bear is big.
The giraffe is tall and the elephant is big.
t: Jirafa katta, fil esa baland boʻyli.
Maymun baland boʻyli, ayiq esa katta.
Jirafa baland boʻyli, fil esa katta.

a2-u9-l2.choice-ahoj-mami-sme.question.en: Emma phones her mum in Dublin from the zoo. What does she say?
a2-u9-l2.choice-ahoj-mami-sme.question.t: Emma hayvonot bogʻidan Dublindagi onasiga qoʻngʻiroq qiladi. U nima deydi?

a2-u9-l2.choice-ahoj-mami-sme.why.en: Family gets ty and **Ahoj**; mami is how you call your mum. Emma is there with Liam and Sarah, so “we are”: **sme**.
a2-u9-l2.choice-ahoj-mami-sme.why.t: Oila aʼzolariga ty va **Ahoj** deyiladi; mami — onaga murojaat («oyi»). Emma Liam va Sara bilan birga, shuning uchun «biz»: **sme**.

a2-u9-l2.speak-ktore-zviera-mas.en.en: Which animal do you like best?

en: You know from A1 that animals add **-a** as objects, like people: Vidím leva, like brat → brata. They follow people in the other cases too: with s it's **-om**, and after o it's **-ovi**, like o Tomášovi.
Pes loses its e (psa, o psovi), and so does tiger (tigra).
t: A1 dan bilasiz: toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda hayvonlar ham odamlar kabi **-a** oladi: Vidím leva, brat → brata kabi. Boshqa kelishiklarda ham ular odamlarga ergashadi: s (bilan) dan keyin **-om**, o (haqida) dan keyin esa **-ovi** keladi, o Tomášovi kabi.
Pes oʻzidagi e ni tushiradi (psa, o psovi), tiger ham (tigra).

a2-u9-l3.fill-emma-vidi-leva.why.en: One lion as the object takes **-a**, like a person: vidí **leva**. Levovi goes after o: o levovi.
a2-u9-l3.fill-emma-vidi-leva.why.t: Bitta sher toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda odam kabi **-a** oladi: vidí **leva**. Levovi o dan keyin keladi: o levovi (sher haqida).

a2-u9-l3.fill-liam-hovori-o.en.en: Liam is talking about the tiger.

a2-u9-l3.fill-liam-hovori-o.why.en: O (about) takes the locative, and an animal adds **-ovi**, like a person: o **tigrovi**, o Tomášovi.
a2-u9-l3.fill-liam-hovori-o.why.t: O (haqida) lokál talab qiladi, hayvon esa odam kabi **-ovi** oladi: o **tigrovi**, o Tomášovi kabi.

en: In the plural, animals switch sides: they change like things (mosty, hotely), not like men. So it's **tie** levy, adjectives end in **-é**, and the object form doesn't change: Vidím levy.
Soft words end in **-e**, like kaviarne: medveď → medvede, kôň → kone, papagáj → papagáje. Tiger drops its e: tigre.
t: Koʻplikda hayvonlar boshqa guruhga oʻtadi: ular erkak kishilar kabi emas, narsalar kabi oʻzgaradi (mosty, hotely). Shuning uchun **tie** levy deyiladi, sifatlar **-é** bilan tugaydi, toʻldiruvchi shakli esa oʻzgarmaydi: Vidím levy.
Yumshoq soʻzlar (ď, ň, j bilan tugaydiganlar) kaviarne kabi **-e** oladi: medveď → medvede, kôň → kone, papagáj → papagáje. Tiger e ni tushiradi: tigre.

en: Sarah can see the elephants and the giraffes.

a2-u9-l3.fill-tie-slony-su.why.en: In the plural, animals change like things: tie **slony**, with -y. Sloni would be the ending for men.
a2-u9-l3.fill-tie-slony-su.why.t: Koʻplikda hayvonlar narsalar kabi oʻzgaradi: tie **slony**, -y bilan. Sloni erkak kishilarning qoʻshimchasi boʻlardi.

a2-u9-l3.fill-sarah-hovori-s.en.en: Sarah is talking to the parrot.

a2-u9-l3.fill-sarah-hovori-s.why.en: S (with) takes the instrumental. One parrot works like a person: s **papagájom**, like s bratom.
a2-u9-l3.fill-sarah-hovori-s.why.t: S (bilan) inštrumentál talab qiladi. Bitta toʻtiqush odam kabi oʻzgaradi: s **papagájom**, s bratom kabi.

a2-u9-l3.choice-tie-papagaje-hovoria.why.en: **Tie papagáje** is plural: soft words end in -e, like kaviarne. The verb is plural too: hovor**ia**.
a2-u9-l3.choice-tie-papagaje-hovoria.why.t: **Tie papagáje** — koʻplik: yumshoq soʻzlar kaviarne kabi -e bilan tugaydi. Feʼl ham koʻplikda: hovor**ia**.

en: Horses in general are plural, and kôň gives **kone**. Koňa is one horse as the object.
Sarah is ona: **miluje**. Milujem is ja.
t: Umuman otlar haqida gap ketganda koʻplik keladi, kôň esa **kone** boʻladi. Koňa — bitta ot, toʻldiruvchi shaklida.

en: Animals count like things too: **dva**, tri, štyri + the plural, dva psy, tri levy. Dvaja, traja, štyria are only for men: dvaja kamaráti.
From five up, the noun takes the -ov form you know from päť rokov: päť slon**ov**, desať papagáj**ov**. Kôň is irregular: päť koní.
t: Hayvonlar ham narsalar kabi sanaladi: **dva**, tri, štyri + koʻplik, dva psy, tri levy. Dvaja, traja, štyria faqat erkak kishilar uchun: dvaja kamaráti. Eʼtibor bering: oʻzbekchada sondan keyin birlik keladi (ikkita it), slovakchada esa koʻplik.
Beshdan boshlab soʻz päť rokov dan tanish -ov shaklini oladi: päť slon**ov**, desať papagáj**ov**. Kôň qoidaga boʻysunmaydi: päť koní.

en: There are two elephants at the zoo.

a2-u9-l3.choice-tri-opice-a.question.en: Sarah can see three monkeys and two bears. What does she say?
a2-u9-l3.choice-tri-opice-a.question.t: Sara uchta maymun va ikkita ayiqni koʻryapti. U nima deydi?

a2-u9-l3.choice-tri-opice-a.why.en: Bears count like things: **dva** medvede. Dvaja is only for men, and the -ov form comes after five.
a2-u9-l3.choice-tri-opice-a.why.t: Ayiqlar narsalar kabi sanaladi: **dva** medvede. Dvaja faqat erkak kishilar uchun, -ov shakli esa beshdan keyin keladi.

a2-u9-l3.fill-v-zoo-je-pat.en.en: There are five elephants at the zoo.

a2-u9-l3.fill-v-zoo-je-pat.why.en: From five up, the -ov form: päť **slonov**, like päť rokov.
a2-u9-l3.fill-v-zoo-je-pat.why.t: Beshdan boshlab -ov shakli: päť **slonov**, päť rokov kabi.

a2-u9-l3.build-v-zoo-su-dva.prompt.en: There are two tigers and a lion at the zoo.
a2-u9-l3.build-v-zoo-su-dva.prompt.t: Hayvonot bogʻida ikkita yoʻlbars va bitta sher bor.

en: Animals count like things: **dva** tigre. Dvaja is for men: dvaja kamaráti.
Animal plurals follow things, and tiger drops its e: **tigre**. Tigri would sound like a group of men.
t: Hayvonlar narsalar kabi sanaladi: **dva** tigre. Dvaja erkak kishilar uchun: dvaja kamaráti.
Hayvonlarning koʻpligi narsalarnikiga ergashadi, tiger esa e ni tushiradi: **tigre**. Tigri bir guruh erkak kishilar haqida gapirgandek eshitiladi.

a2-u9-l3.choice-liam-hlada-psa.question.en: Which sentence is about one dog?

a2-u9-l3.choice-liam-hlada-psa.why.en: **Psa** is one dog as the object, like a person. Psy is the plural, which works like things.
a2-u9-l3.choice-liam-hlada-psa.why.t: **Psa** — bitta it, toʻldiruvchi shaklida, odam kabi. Psy — koʻplik, u narsalar kabi oʻzgaradi.

a2-u9-l3.build-videli-sme-tri.prompt.en: We saw three bears and five lions.
a2-u9-l3.build-videli-sme-tri.prompt.t: Biz uchta ayiq va beshta sherni koʻrdik.

en: Bears count like things: **tri** medvede. Traja is for men.
After five comes the -ov form: päť **levov**. Levy is for two to four.
t: Ayiqlar narsalar kabi sanaladi: **tri** medvede. Traja erkak kishilar uchun.
Beshdan keyin -ov shakli keladi: päť **levov**. Levy ikkidan toʻrtgacha uchun.

a2-u9-l3.speak-v-zoo-su-dva.en.en: There are two elephants at the zoo.

a2-u9-l4.titleEn.en: Shall we go to the circus?

a2-u9-l4.cirkus.note.en: Ideme **do cirkusu**. = We're going to the circus. Cirkus **bez** zvierat = a circus without animals.
a2-u9-l4.cirkus.note.t: Ideme **do cirkusu**. = Sirkka ketyapmiz. Cirkus **bez** zvierat = hayvonlarsiz sirk.

a2-u9-l4.predstavenie.note.en: Predstavenie začína o siedmej. = The show starts at seven.
a2-u9-l4.predstavenie.note.t: Predstavenie začína o siedmej. = Tomosha soat yettida boshlanadi.

a2-u9-l4.choice-pozyvam-vas-do.question.en: Sarah has seen a circus poster in town. Emma invites her and Liam. What does she say?
a2-u9-l4.choice-pozyvam-vas-do.question.t: Sara shaharda sirk afishasini koʻrdi. Emma uni va Liamni taklif qiladi. U nima deydi?

a2-u9-l4.choice-pozyvam-vas-do.why.en: Two people are vy, so the object form is **vás**. Ťa is for one friend.
a2-u9-l4.choice-pozyvam-vas-do.why.t: Ikki kishi — vy, shuning uchun toʻldiruvchi shakli **vás** (sizlarni). Ťa — bitta doʻst uchun.

a2-u9-l4.tyranie-zvierat.note.en: **týrať** = to treat cruelly. Zvierat = of animals; cirkus **so zvieratami** = a circus with animals. **Podľa mňa** je to týranie zvierat. = In my opinion, it's cruelty to animals.
a2-u9-l4.tyranie-zvierat.note.t: **týrať** = qiynamoq, shafqatsizlarcha muomala qilmoq. Zvierat = hayvonlarning; cirkus **so zvieratami** = hayvonli sirk. **Podľa mňa** je to týranie zvierat. = Menimcha, bu hayvonlarni qiynash.

a2-u9-l4.choice-cirkus-so-zvieratami.que.en: Liam doesn't like circuses with animals. What does he say?
a2-u9-l4.choice-cirkus-so-zvieratami.que.t: Liamga hayvonli sirklar yoqmaydi. U nima deydi?

a2-u9-l4.uznavam.note.en: From **uznávať** (to admit). Uznávam, máš **pravdu**. = I admit you're right.
a2-u9-l4.uznavam.note.t: **uznávať** (tan olmoq) feʼlidan. Uznávam, máš **pravdu**. = Tan olaman, haqsan.

a2-u9-l4.fill-uznavam-mas-pravdu.why.en: Liam is talking about himself, ja, so the verb ends in **-m**: uznáva**m**.
a2-u9-l4.fill-uznavam-mas-pravdu.why.t: Liam oʻzi haqida gapiryapti, ja, shuning uchun feʼl **-m** bilan tugaydi: uznáva**m**.

a2-u9-l4.zmenit-nazor.note.en: **názor** = opinion. Ľudia menia názory. = People change their minds.
a2-u9-l4.zmenit-nazor.note.t: **názor** = fikr. Ľudia menia názory. = Odamlar fikrini oʻzgartiradi.

a2-u9-l4.fill-liam-zmenil-nazor.en.en: A circus without animals? Liam has changed his mind.

a2-u9-l4.fill-liam-zmenil-nazor.why.en: Liam is a man, so the past ends in **-l**: zmenil.
a2-u9-l4.fill-liam-zmenil-nazor.why.t: Liam — erkak, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-l** bilan tugaydi: zmenil.

a2-u9-l4.hodi-sa-vam.note.en: **hodiť sa** = to suit, to be convenient. Who it suits takes the to-whom form: Hodí sa **mi** to. = That suits me. To one friend: Hodí sa **ti** to?
a2-u9-l4.hodi-sa-vam.note.t: **hodiť sa** = qulay boʻlmoq, toʻgʻri kelmoq. Kimga qulay boʻlsa, u datívda (joʻnalish kelishigida) keladi, xuddi oʻzbekchadagi -ga kabi: Hodí sa **mi** to. = Bu menga qulay. Doʻstga: Hodí sa **ti** to?

a2-u9-l4.listky-su-vypredane.note.en: You know vypredaný from the castle in May: Prehliadka je vypredaná. It comes from vypredať (to sell out), and this unit has more words like it.
a2-u9-l4.listky-su-vypredane.note.t: vypredaný soʻzini may oyidagi Orava qalʼasi ekskursiyasidan bilasiz: Prehliadka je vypredaná. U vypredať (sotib tugatmoq) feʼlidan yasalgan; bu boʻlimda shunday soʻzlar yana koʻp.

a2-u9-l4.choice-listky-na-sobotu.questio.en: The woman at the box office says this. What does she offer?
a2-u9-l4.choice-listky-na-sobotu.questio.t: Kassadagi ayol shunday deydi. U nimani taklif qilyapti?

a2-u9-l4.fill-nedela-sa-nam.why.en: Like páčiť sa, the thing that suits is the subject (nedeľa), and the people it suits take the to-whom form: **nám**.
a2-u9-l4.fill-nedela-sa-nam.why.t: páčiť sa dagi kabi, qulay boʻlgan narsa ega boʻladi (nedeľa), kimga qulay boʻlsa, u «kimga?» shaklida keladi: **nám** (bizga).

a2-u9-l4.build-su-listky-na.prompt.en: Are the tickets for Saturday sold out?

en: Lístky is plural, so the ending is **-é**: vypredan**é**, like nové mosty.
For a day, na takes the object form: na sobot**u**.
t: Lístky — koʻplik, shuning uchun qoʻshimcha **-é**: vypredan**é**, nové mosty kabi.
Kun bilan na toʻldiruvchi shaklini talab qiladi: na sobot**u** (shanbaga).

en: In my opinion it's cruelty to animals.

a2-u9-l5.artistka.note.en: In a circus, artisti walk on ropes, fly through the air and juggle.
a2-u9-l5.artistka.note.t: Sirkda artisti (artistlar) arqonda yuradi, havoda uchadi va jonglyorlik qiladi.

en: The performer is dancing on the stage.
The clown is dancing on the rope.
The performer is dancing on the rope.

a2-u9-l5.klaun.note.en: Plural like men: **klauni**. An old word for a clown or a fool is **šašo**.
a2-u9-l5.klaun.note.t: Koʻplikda erkak kishilar kabi: **klauni**. Kloun yoki tentak uchun eski soʻz — **šašo** (masxaraboz).

a2-u9-l5.fill-dvaja-klauni-zongluju.why.en: Dvaja klauni are oni, so the verb ends in **-ú**: žongluj**ú**, like študujú.
a2-u9-l5.fill-dvaja-klauni-zongluju.why.t: Dvaja klauni — oni, shuning uchun feʼl **-ú** bilan tugaydi: žongluj**ú**, študujú kabi.

a2-u9-l5.vystupovat.note.en: V cirkuse **vystupujú** artisti a klauni. = Performers and clowns perform at the circus.
a2-u9-l5.vystupovat.note.t: V cirkuse **vystupujú** artisti a klauni. = Sirkda artistlar va klounlar chiqish qiladi.

a2-u9-l5.choice-traja-akrobati-vystupuju.en: Three acrobats are performing. Which is right?
a2-u9-l5.choice-traja-akrobati-vystupuju.t: Uchta akrobat chiqish qilyapti. Qaysi biri toʻgʻri?

a2-u9-l5.choice-traja-akrobati-vystupuju.en: Acrobats are people: men count with **traja** and take the men's plural, akrobat**i**. Tri with -y is for animals and things.
a2-u9-l5.choice-traja-akrobati-vystupuju.t: Akrobatlar — odamlar: erkak kishilar **traja** bilan sanaladi va erkaklar koʻpligini oladi: akrobat**i**. -y bilan kelgan tri hayvonlar va narsalar uchun.

a2-u9-l5.vzrusujuci.note.en: Its endings: vzrušujúci, vzrušujúca, vzrušujúce. Predstavenie bolo **vzrušujúce**! = The show was exciting!
a2-u9-l5.vzrusujuci.note.t: Uning shakllari: vzrušujúci, vzrušujúca, vzrušujúce. Predstavenie bolo **vzrušujúce**! = Tomosha hayajonli boʻldi!

a2-u9-l5.fill-predstavenie-bolo-vzrusuju.en: Predstavenie is neuter, so the adjective takes the neuter ending, here **-e**: vzrušujúc**e**.
a2-u9-l5.fill-predstavenie-bolo-vzrusuju.t: Predstavenie — oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun sifat oʻrta jins qoʻshimchasini oladi, bu yerda **-e**: vzrušujúc**e**.

a2-u9-l5.build-artistka-tancuje-na.promp.en: The performer is dancing on the rope.

en: On the rope answers “where?”, so na takes the locative: na **lane**, like v meste.
t: «Arqonda» «qayerda?» savoliga javob beradi, shuning uchun na lokál talab qiladi: na **lane**, v meste kabi (oʻzbekchadagi -da).

en: The clowns are juggling and the acrobats are performing.
t: Klounlar jonglyorlik qilyapti, akrobatlar esa chiqish qilyapti.
Klounlar jonglyorlik qilyapti va akrobatlar chiqish qilyapti.

a2-u9-l5.choice-to-bolo-vzrusujuce.quest.en: Sarah says this after the show. What does she mean?
a2-u9-l5.choice-to-bolo-vzrusujuce.quest.t: Sara tomoshadan keyin shunday deydi. U nima demoqchi?

en: Slovak can turn a verb into an adjective that says what someone is doing right now: a lion that is sleeping is a **spiaci** lev. You'll mostly read and hear these. In speech, Slovaks often say lev, ktorý spí.

Take the oni form: -ú or -ia goes, and **-úci** or **-iaci** comes in: spia → spiaci, plávajú → plávajúci. It changes like an adjective: -i for masculine, **-a** for feminine, **-e** for neuter and for the plural (only men keep -i).
t: Slovak tilida feʼldan hozir biror ishni qilayotgan kishi yoki hayvonni bildiruvchi sifat yasash mumkin: uxlayotgan sher — **spiaci** lev. Bu oʻzbekchadagi -yotgan sifatdoshiga oʻxshaydi: uxla-yotgan. Bunday soʻzlarni asosan oʻqiysiz va eshitasiz; ogʻzaki nutqda slovaklar koʻpincha lev, ktorý spí («uxlab yotgan sher») deydi.

oni shaklini oling: -ú yoki -ia tushadi, oʻrniga **-úci** yoki **-iaci** keladi: spia → spiaci, plávajú → plávajúci. U sifat kabi oʻzgaradi: erkak jinsida -i, ayol jinsida **-a**, oʻrta jinsda va koʻplikda **-e** (faqat erkak kishilar -i ni saqlaydi).

en: That talking parrot can speak Slovak.
t: Anavi gapiradigan toʻtiqush slovakcha gapira oladi.

a2-u9-l6.choice-co-je-spiaci.why.en: Spiaci comes from spať (to sleep): spia → **spiaci**, the lion who is sleeping.
a2-u9-l6.choice-co-je-spiaci.why.t: Spiaci spať (uxlamoq) feʼlidan: spia → **spiaci**, yaʼni uxlayotgan sher.

a2-u9-l6.fill-tam-je-spiaca.why.en: Opica is feminine, so the -ci word ends in **-a**: spiac**a** opica.
a2-u9-l6.fill-tam-je-spiaca.why.t: Opica — ayol jinsida, shuning uchun -ci soʻzi **-a** bilan tugaydi: spiac**a** opica.

a2-u9-l6.fill-spiaci-lev-je.en.en: A sleeping lion is a lion that is asleep.
a2-u9-l6.fill-spiaci-lev-je.en.t: Uxlayotgan sher — bu hozir uxlab yotgan sher.

a2-u9-l6.fill-spiaci-lev-je.why.en: A -ci word says what someone is doing now, so the ktorý clause uses the present, for one lion: **spí**.
a2-u9-l6.fill-spiaci-lev-je.why.t: -ci soʻzi hozir nima qilinayotganini bildiradi, shuning uchun ktorý bilan boshlangan qismda hozirgi zamon keladi, bitta sher uchun: **spí**.

a2-u9-l6.choice-sarah-vidi-plavajuce.why.en: **Plávajúce** comes from plávať (plávajú): crocodiles who are swimming. It ends in -e for animals in the plural.
a2-u9-l6.choice-sarah-vidi-plavajuce.why.t: **Plávajúce** plávať (plávajú) feʼlidan: suzayotgan timsohlar. Hayvonlar koʻplikda boʻlgani uchun -e bilan tugaydi.

en: Some -úci words have become everyday words. Used as nouns, they keep adjective endings: môj vedúci (my boss), moja vedúca (my boss, a woman).
Budúci and nasledujúci both mean “next”: budúci týždeň (next week), nasledujúca zastávka (the next stop).
t: Baʼzi -úci soʻzlari oddiy kundalik soʻzga aylangan. Ot sifatida ishlatilganda ham sifat qoʻshimchalarini saqlaydi: môj vedúci (boshligʻim), moja vedúca (boshligʻim, ayol).
Budúci va nasledujúci ikkalasi ham «keyingi» degani: budúci týždeň (kelasi hafta), nasledujúca zastávka (keyingi bekat).

en: Next week I'll be in Dublin.

a2-u9-l6.fill-lucia-je-moja.why.en: Lucia is a woman, so the feminine ending **-a**, like moja: spolubývajúc**a**.
a2-u9-l6.fill-lucia-je-moja.why.t: Lusiya — ayol, shuning uchun ayol jinsi qoʻshimchasi **-a**, moja kabi: spolubývajúc**a**.

a2-u9-l6.fill-moj-veduci-je.en.en: My boss is in a meeting today.

a2-u9-l6.fill-moj-veduci-je.why.en: Môj is masculine, so the boss is a man: **vedúci**. A woman would be moja vedúca.
a2-u9-l6.fill-moj-veduci-je.why.t: Môj — erkak jinsida, demak boshliq erkak: **vedúci**. Ayol boʻlsa, moja vedúca.

a2-u9-l6.choice-nasledujuca-zastavka-zoo.en: Emma, Liam and Sarah hear this on the bus. What does it mean?
a2-u9-l6.choice-nasledujuca-zastavka-zoo.t: Emma, Liam va Sara avtobusda buni eshitishadi. Bu nimani anglatadi?

en: This bus doesn't stop at the zoo.

a2-u9-l6.build-buduci-tyzden-idu.prompt.en: Liam and Sarah are going home next week.
a2-u9-l6.build-buduci-tyzden-idu.prompt.t: Liam va Sara kelasi hafta uyga ketishadi.

a2-u9-l6.grammar-participles-sa.title.en: With sa, and spiaci or spací?
a2-u9-l6.grammar-participles-sa.title.t: sa bilan, hamda spiaci yoki spací?

en: Verbs with sa keep it after the -úci word: hrajúce **sa** deti, children playing (hrať sa, to play).
Don't mix them up with adjectives in **-cí**, which say what a thing is for: a spací vak is a sleeping bag, a bag for sleeping. A spiaci chlapec is a boy who is asleep.
t: sa bilan keladigan feʼllar -úci soʻzidan keyin ham sa ni saqlaydi: hrajúce **sa** deti, oʻynayotgan bolalar (hrať sa — oʻynamoq).

Ularni **-cí** bilan tugaydigan sifatlar bilan adashtirmang: bular narsa nima uchun moʻljallanganini aytadi. spací vak — uxlash uchun xalta, yaʼni uxlash xaltasi. spiaci chlapec esa hozir uxlab yotgan bola.

en: There are children playing in the park.
Liam is sleeping in a sleeping bag.

a2-u9-l6.choice-ktory-je-spaci.question.en: Which one is a sleeping bag?

a2-u9-l6.choice-ktory-je-spaci.why.en: A bag for sleeping takes **-cí**: spací vak. Spiaci means “who is sleeping right now”.
a2-u9-l6.choice-ktory-je-spaci.why.t: Uxlash uchun moʻljallangan xalta **-cí** oladi: spací vak. Spiaci «hozir uxlayotgan» degani.

a2-u9-l6.choice-hrajuce-sa-deti.why.en: From hrať sa (to play): hrajú sa → hrajúce **sa**. Verbs with sa keep it after the -úci word.
a2-u9-l6.choice-hrajuce-sa-deti.why.t: hrať sa (oʻynamoq) feʼlidan: hrajú sa → hrajúce **sa**. sa bilan keladigan feʼllar -úci soʻzidan keyin ham uni saqlaydi.

en: The passengers are waiting for the bus.

a2-u9-l7.babka-a-vnuk.note.en: Marek calls babka Helena **babi**, the way you say mami to Mum. You know he's her vnuk and Lucia her vnučka from Christmas.
a2-u9-l7.babka-a-vnuk.note.t: Marek Helena buvini **babi** deb chaqiradi, onaga mami (oyi) deganingiz kabi. Marek uning vnuk (nevarasi), Lusiya esa vnučka (nevara qizi) ekanini Rojdestvo darslaridan bilasiz.

a2-u9-l7.kolac.note.en: A simple home-made cake, often baked in a tin. **babkin koláč** = Grandma's cake (babka → babkin, like Emma → Emmin).
a2-u9-l7.kolac.note.t: Uyda pishiriladigan oddiy pirog, koʻpincha qolipda pishiriladi. **babkin koláč** = buvining pirogi (babka → babkin, Emma → Emmin kabi).

a2-u9-l7.recept.note.en: **recept na** koláč = a recipe for a cake. At the doctor's, a recept is a prescription.
a2-u9-l7.recept.note.t: **recept na** koláč = pirog retsepti. Shifokorda recept — dori retsepti, xuddi oʻzbekchadagidek.

a2-u9-l7.choice-marek-telefonuje-s.quest.en: Marek wants to cook dinner for Veronika, the doctor he met in winter. Why is he phoning his grandmother?
a2-u9-l7.choice-marek-telefonuje-s.quest.t: Marek qishda tanishgan shifokor Veronikaga kechki ovqat tayyorlamoqchi. U nega buvisiga qoʻngʻiroq qilyapti?

en: He wants her to bake him a cake.
He wants to invite her to dinner.
t: Buvisi unga pirog pishirib berishini xohlaydi.

a2-u9-l7.dlho-si-sa.en.en: We haven't heard from you for ages!

a2-u9-l7.dlho-si-sa.note.en: **ozvať sa** = to get in touch. Babka says **nám**, “to us”: the whole family in Žilina.
a2-u9-l7.dlho-si-sa.note.t: **ozvať sa** = xabar bermoq, bogʻlanmoq. Buvi **nám** («bizga») deydi: Jilinadagi butun oila nomidan.

a2-u9-l7.fill-prepac-ze-som.en.en: Hi, Grandma! Sorry I haven't been in touch for so long.
a2-u9-l7.fill-prepac-ze-som.en.t: Salom, buvijon! Anchadan beri xabar bermaganim uchun kechir.

a2-u9-l7.fill-prepac-ze-som.why.en: Marek is a man, so the past ends in **-l**: neozval. Lucia would say neozvala.
a2-u9-l7.fill-prepac-ze-som.why.t: Marek — erkak, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-l** bilan tugaydi: neozval. Lusiya neozvala derdi.

a2-u9-l7.stalo-sa-nieco.en.en: Has something happened? — No, don't worry.
a2-u9-l7.stalo-sa-nieco.en.t: Biror narsa boʻldimi? — Yoʻq, xavotir olma.

a2-u9-l7.stalo-sa-nieco.note.en: **Neboj sa!** = Don't worry! To vy: Nebojte sa! It comes from báť sa, to be afraid.
a2-u9-l7.stalo-sa-nieco.note.t: **Neboj sa!** = Xavotir olma! vy ga: Nebojte sa! báť sa (qoʻrqmoq) feʼlidan.

a2-u9-l7.choice-nie-neboj-sa.question.en: Babka asks: Stalo sa niečo? Marek wants to calm her down. What does he say?
a2-u9-l7.choice-nie-neboj-sa.question.t: Buvi soʻraydi: Stalo sa niečo? Marek uni tinchlantirmoqchi. U nima deydi?

a2-u9-l7.choice-nie-neboj-sa.why.en: Marek says ty to his grandmother, so **neboj sa**. Nebojte sa is for vy.
a2-u9-l7.choice-nie-neboj-sa.why.t: Marek buvisiga ty deydi, shuning uchun **neboj sa**. Nebojte sa vy uchun. (Oʻzbek oilalarida buviga odatda «siz» deyiladi, slovaklar esa oilada ty ishlatadi.)

a2-u9-l7.zvladnut.note.en: It's perfective, so its present form means the future: **Zvládnem to.** = I'll manage.
a2-u9-l7.zvladnut.note.t: Bu tugallangan tur feʼli, shuning uchun hozirgi zamon shakli kelasi zamonni bildiradi: **Zvládnem to.** = Uddalayman.

a2-u9-l7.si-si-isty.note.en: **istý** = sure. Si si istý, že to zvládneš? = Are you sure you'll manage?
a2-u9-l7.si-si-isty.note.t: **istý** = amin, ishonchi komil. Si si istý, že to zvládneš? = Uddalay olishingga ishonching komilmi?

a2-u9-l7.fill-si-si-isty.why.en: Babka is talking to Marek, a man, so **istý**. To Lucia she'd say istá.
a2-u9-l7.fill-si-si-isty.why.t: Buvi Marek bilan, yaʼni erkak bilan gaplashyapti, shuning uchun **istý**. Lusiyaga istá derdi.

en: Marek is talking about himself, ja: **zvládnem**. Zvládneš is ty.
To one person you say ty: **neboj** sa. Nebojte sa is for vy.
t: Marek oʻzi haqida gapiryapti, ja: **zvládnem**. Zvládneš — ty shakli.
Bitta kishiga ty deysiz: **neboj** sa. Nebojte sa vy uchun.

a2-u9-l7.build-mama-hovori-ze.prompt.en: Mum says you've got the best recipe.
a2-u9-l7.build-mama-hovori-ze.prompt.t: Oyimning aytishicha, eng yaxshi retsept sende.

en: Recept is masculine, so the ending is **-í**: najlepš**í** recept.
Marek is talking to babka, ty: **máš**.
t: Recept — erkak jinsida, shuning uchun qoʻshimcha **-í**: najlepš**í** recept.

en: Are you sure you will manage?

a2-u9-l8.vajce.note.en: More than one: **vajcia**. Slovaks often say vajíčko.

a2-u9-l8.muka.note.en: **hrubá múka** = coarse flour, the kind many Slovak cakes use.
a2-u9-l8.muka.note.t: **hrubá múka** = yirik tortilgan un, koʻp slovak piroglari shu undan pishiriladi.

a2-u9-l8.choice-potrebujes-vajcia-a.ques.en: Babka starts the list. What does Marek need?
a2-u9-l8.choice-potrebujes-vajcia-a.ques.t: Buvi roʻyxatni boshlaydi. Marekka nima kerak?

a2-u9-l8.cukor.note.en: **práškový cukor** = icing sugar. Káva s cukrom = coffee with sugar.
a2-u9-l8.cukor.note.t: **práškový cukor** = shakar upasi. Káva s cukrom = shakarli qahva.

a2-u9-l8.fill-potrebujes-aj-praskovy.why.en: Cukor is masculine, so the adjective ends in **-ý**: práškov**ý** cukor.
a2-u9-l8.fill-potrebujes-aj-praskovy.why.t: Cukor — erkak jinsida, shuning uchun sifat **-ý** bilan tugaydi: práškov**ý** cukor.

a2-u9-l8.prasok-do-peciva.note.en: Literally “powder for baking”. Its other name is **kypriaci prášok**.
a2-u9-l8.prasok-do-peciva.note.t: Soʻzma-soʻz «pishiriq uchun kukun». Boshqa nomi — **kypriaci prášok**.

a2-u9-l8.build-potrebujem-vajcia-olej.pr.en: I need eggs, oil and flour.
a2-u9-l8.build-potrebujem-vajcia-olej.pr.t: Menga tuxum, yogʻ va un kerak.

en: The flour is what you need, the object: -a → **-u**, múk**u**.
t: Bir nechta tuxum — koʻplik: **vajcia**. Oʻzbekchada «tuxum» birlikda ham koʻpni bildiradi, slovakchada esa koʻplik kerak.
Un — sizga kerak narsa, toʻldiruvchi: -a → **-u**, múk**u**.

a2-u9-l8.fill-kupim-cerstve-jahody.why.en: Jahody is plural, so the adjective ends in **-é**: čerstv**é** jahody, like zelené jablká.
a2-u9-l8.fill-kupim-cerstve-jahody.why.t: Jahody — koʻplik, shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi: čerstv**é** jahody, zelené jablká kabi.

a2-u9-l8.choice-co-pomoze-kolacu.questio.en: Which one makes a cake rise?

en: Can you buy milk and butter?
Have you got milk and butter at home?
Do you like milk and butter?
t: Sut va sariyogʻ sotib ola olasanmi?

a2-u9-l8.si-poklad.note.en: **poklad** = treasure. Babka answers: Ďakujem, **zlatko**! (darling) Or **synček**, “my boy”, the way grandmothers talk to grandsons.
a2-u9-l8.si-poklad.note.t: **poklad** = xazina. Buvi javob beradi: Ďakujem, **zlatko**! (jonim) Yoki **synček** — «bolam, oʻgʻlim»: buvilar nevaralariga shunday deydi.

a2-u9-l8.choice-babi-si-poklad.question.en: Babka has given Marek the whole recipe. What does he say?
a2-u9-l8.choice-babi-si-poklad.question.t: Buvi Marekka butun retseptni aytib berdi. U nima deydi?

en: Thank you, my boy. You're my treasure too.
t: Rahmat, bolam. Sen ham mening xazinamsan.
Rahmat, oʻgʻlim. Sen ham mening xazinamsan.

a2-u9-l9.kilo.note.en: **pol kila** = half a kilo. At the market: Prosím si kilo jahôd. = A kilo of strawberries, please.
a2-u9-l9.kilo.note.t: **pol kila** = yarim kilo. Bozorda: Prosím si kilo jahôd. = Bir kilo qulupnay, iltimos.

a2-u9-l9.gram.note.en: dvesto **gramov** = 200 grams. Slovaks also weigh in deka, ten grams: desať deka syra.
a2-u9-l9.gram.note.t: dvesto **gramov** = 200 gramm. Slovaklar deka bilan ham tortadi, bu oʻn gramm: desať deka syra = 100 gramm pishloq.

en: You know šálka čaju and kilo múky from unit 5: after a measure, the food takes the genitive, the “of” form. A recipe adds lyžica, vrecko and štipka, and these foods' genitives are worth learning: kilo **jahôd**, päť **vajec**, štipka **soli**.
t: šálka čaju va kilo múky ni 5-boʻlimdan bilasiz: oʻlchovdan keyin mahsulot genitívda (qaratqich kelishigida), yaʼni «nimaning?» shaklida keladi. Oʻzbekchada «bir kilo un» deymiz va un oʻzgarmaydi, slovakchada esa u oʻzgaradi. Retseptda lyžica, vrecko va štipka ham bor; bu mahsulotlarning genitív shaklini yodlab oling: kilo **jahôd**, päť **vajec**, štipka **soli**.

en: We need a cup of flour.

a2-u9-l9.fill-prosim-si-pol.en.en: Half a kilo of strawberries, please.

a2-u9-l9.fill-prosim-si-pol.why.en: After a quantity like pol kila, the food takes the of-form: **jahôd**.
a2-u9-l9.fill-prosim-si-pol.why.t: pol kila kabi miqdordan keyin mahsulot genitívda («nimaning?» shaklida) keladi: **jahôd**.

a2-u9-l9.lyzica.note.en: **lyžička** = a teaspoon. Dve lyžice oleja = two spoonfuls of oil.
a2-u9-l9.lyzica.note.t: **lyžička** = choy qoshiq. Dve lyžice oleja = ikki qoshiq yogʻ.

a2-u9-l9.salka.note.en: In recipes it's also a measure: šálka múky. **Šálka kávy** = a cup of coffee.
a2-u9-l9.salka.note.t: Retseptlarda bu oʻlchov ham: šálka múky (bir chashka un). **Šálka kávy** = bir chashka qahva.

a2-u9-l9.fill-potrebujes-dve-lyzice.en.en: You need two spoonfuls of oil.

a2-u9-l9.fill-potrebujes-dve-lyzice.why.en: After a quantity, the of-form: lyžica **oleja**. Masculine words take -a here.
a2-u9-l9.fill-potrebujes-dve-lyzice.why.t: Miqdordan keyin genitív: lyžica **oleja**. Erkak jinsidagi soʻzlar bu yerda -a oladi.

a2-u9-l9.vrecko.note.en: vrecko prášku do pečiva = a sachet of baking powder
a2-u9-l9.vrecko.note.t: vrecko prášku do pečiva = bir paketcha qabartiruvchi kukun

a2-u9-l9.sol.note.en: Feminine. **štipka soli** = a pinch of salt.
a2-u9-l9.sol.note.t: Ayol jinsida. **štipka soli** = bir chimdim tuz.

a2-u9-l9.build-prosim-si-kilo.prompt.en: A kilo of strawberries and ten eggs, please.
a2-u9-l9.build-prosim-si-kilo.prompt.t: Bir kilo qulupnay va oʻnta tuxum, iltimos.

a2-u9-l9.build-potrebujeme-vrecko-prasku.t: Bizga bir paketcha qabartiruvchi kukun kerak.

a2-u9-l10.piect-upiect.note.en: You know **upiecť** from unit 2: Upečiem tortu, upiekol, upiekla. Its imperfective partner is **piecť**: **Pečiem** koláč. = I'm baking a cake (it's in the oven). Past: piekol, piekla.
a2-u9-l10.piect-upiect.note.t: **upiecť** ni 2-boʻlimdan bilasiz: Upečiem tortu, upiekol, upiekla. Uning tugallanmagan turdagi jufti — **piecť**: **Pečiem** koláč. = Pirog pishiryapman (u hozir pechda). Oʻtgan zamon: piekol, piekla.

a2-u9-l10.choice-zajtra-upeciem-kolac.qu.en: Marek tells Lucia his plan. When will the cake be ready?
a2-u9-l10.choice-zajtra-upeciem-kolac.qu.t: Marek Lusiyaga rejasini aytyapti. Pirog qachon tayyor boʻladi?

a2-u9-l10.choice-zajtra-upeciem-kolac.wh.en: **Upečiem** is perfective, so its present form means the future, like napíšem.
a2-u9-l10.choice-zajtra-upeciem-kolac.wh.t: **Upečiem** — tugallangan tur, shuning uchun hozirgi zamon shakli kelasi zamonni bildiradi, napíšem kabi.

a2-u9-l10.miesat-vymiesat.note.en: Recipes speak as my (we): **Vymiešame** vajcia s cukrom. = We mix the eggs with the sugar.
a2-u9-l10.miesat-vymiesat.note.t: Retseptlar my (biz) nomidan gapiradi: **Vymiešame** vajcia s cukrom. = Tuxumni shakar bilan aralashtiramiz.

a2-u9-l10.fill-najprv-vymiesame-vajcia.e.en: First we mix the eggs with the sugar.

a2-u9-l10.fill-najprv-vymiesame-vajcia.w.en: Recipes speak as my (we), so the verb ends in **-me**: vymieša**me**.
a2-u9-l10.fill-najprv-vymiesame-vajcia.w.t: Retseptlar my (biz) nomidan gapiradi, shuning uchun feʼl **-me** bilan tugaydi: vymieša**me**.

a2-u9-l10.pridat.note.en: Perfective, like kúpiť: **Pridáme** múku. = We add the flour.
a2-u9-l10.pridat.note.t: kúpiť kabi tugallangan tur: **Pridáme** múku. = Unni qoʻshamiz.

a2-u9-l10.build-potom-pridame-olej.promp.en: Then we add the oil and the milk.

en: A recipe speaks as my (we): **pridáme**. Pridám is ja.
There's no quantity here: the oil is just the object, and masculine things don't change, **olej**.
t: Retsept my (biz) nomidan gapiradi: **pridáme**. Pridám — ja shakli.
Bu yerda miqdor yoʻq: yogʻ shunchaki toʻldiruvchi, erkak jinsidagi narsalar esa oʻzgarmaydi: **olej**.

a2-u9-l10.rura.note.en: Pečieme v rúre na sto osemdesiat **stupňoch**. = We bake in the oven at 180 degrees. The baking tin is a **plech**.
a2-u9-l10.rura.note.t: Pečieme v rúre na sto osemdesiat **stupňoch**. = Duxovkada 180 darajada pishiramiz. Pishiriq tunukasi (patnis) — **plech**.

a2-u9-l10.fill-kolac-pecieme-v.en.en: We bake the cake in the oven.

a2-u9-l10.fill-kolac-pecieme-v.why.en: V for “where” takes the locative: rúra → v **rúre**, like škola → v škole.

a2-u9-l10.vychladnut.note.en: Perfective. While it's happening, the imperfective: Koláč **chladne**. = The cake is cooling.
a2-u9-l10.vychladnut.note.t: Tugallangan tur. Jarayon davom etayotganda tugallanmagan tur ishlatiladi: Koláč **chladne**. = Pirog sovuyapti.

a2-u9-l10.choice-teraz-peciem-kolac.ques.en: Lucia phones. Marek's cake is in the oven right now. What does he say?

a2-u9-l10.choice-teraz-peciem-kolac.why.en: What's going on right now is imperfective: **pečiem**. Upečiem is perfective, so it means the future.
a2-u9-l10.choice-teraz-peciem-kolac.why.t: Hozir boʻlayotgan ish — tugallanmagan tur: **pečiem**. Upečiem tugallangan tur, shuning uchun kelasi zamonni bildiradi.

a2-u9-l12.v-piatok-byvaju.note.en: You know **bývať** as “to live”. It's also byť for what usually happens: Reštaurácia je plná (now). V piatok **býva** plná (most Fridays). **plný** = full.
a2-u9-l12.v-piatok-byvaju.note.t: **bývať** ni «yashamoq» maʼnosida bilasiz. U odatda boʻladigan narsa uchun byť vazifasini ham bajaradi: Reštaurácia je plná (hozir). V piatok **býva** plná (deyarli har juma). **plný** = toʻla.

a2-u9-l12.fill-cez-vikend-byvaju.en.en: At the weekend restaurants are usually full.

a2-u9-l12.fill-cez-vikend-byvaju.why.en: Reštaurácie are oni, so bývať takes **bývajú**, like byť → sú.
a2-u9-l12.fill-cez-vikend-byvaju.why.t: Reštaurácie — oni, shuning uchun bývať **bývajú** shaklida keladi, byť → sú kabi.

a2-u9-l12.choice-uvaril-by-som.question.en: Lucia asks: Čo uvaríš? Marek hasn't decided yet. What does he say?
a2-u9-l12.choice-uvaril-by-som.question.t: Lusiya soʻraydi: Čo uvaríš? Marek hali qaror qilmagan. U nima deydi?

a2-u9-l12.choice-uvaril-by-som.why.en: Marek is a man talking about himself, so **uvaril by som**: “I would cook”. Uvarila is a woman's form, and by si is ty.
a2-u9-l12.choice-uvaril-by-som.why.t: Marek — oʻzi haqida gapirayotgan erkak, shuning uchun **uvaril by som**: «pishirardim». Uvarila — ayol shakli, by si esa ty.

a2-u9-l12.prekvapenie.note.en: Je to **prekvapenie**. = It's a surprise. Som prekvapená! = I'm surprised! (a woman)
a2-u9-l12.prekvapenie.note.t: Je to **prekvapenie**. = Bu syurpriz. Som prekvapená! = Hayronman! (ayol)

a2-u9-l12.choice-to-je-tajomstvo.questio.en: Veronika asks why he's inviting her. Marek doesn't want to tell her yet. What does he say?
a2-u9-l12.choice-to-je-tajomstvo.questio.t: Veronika nega uni taklif qilayotganini soʻraydi. Marek hozircha aytmoqchi emas. U nima deydi?

a2-u9-l12.fill-v-piatok-ano.why.en: **To** (that) is the subject, so the verb takes the on, ona, ono form: to sa mi **hodí**, like páči sa mi.
a2-u9-l12.fill-v-piatok-ano.why.t: **To** (bu) — ega, shuning uchun feʼl on, ona, ono shaklida keladi: to sa mi **hodí**, páči sa mi kabi.

a2-u9-l12.vynimocny.note.en: Dnes je **výnimočný** deň. = Today is a special day.
a2-u9-l12.vynimocny.note.t: Dnes je **výnimočný** deň. = Bugun alohida kun.

en: Today is now, so byť is in the present: **je**. Bude is the future.
t: Bugun — hozir, shuning uchun byť hozirgi zamonda: **je**. Bude — kelasi zamon.

a2-u9-l12.choice-ktora-veta-znamena.ques.en: Which sentence means “Restaurants are usually full on Fridays”?
a2-u9-l12.choice-ktora-veta-znamena.ques.t: Qaysi gap «Juma kunlari restoranlar odatda toʻla boʻladi» degani?

a2-u9-l12.choice-ktora-veta-znamena.why.en: **Bývajú** says what usually happens. Boli is last Friday, and budú is next Friday.
a2-u9-l12.choice-ktora-veta-znamena.why.t: **Bývajú** odatda nima boʻlishini aytadi. Boli — oʻtgan juma, budú — kelasi juma.

en: To say a thing has had something done to it, Slovak turns the verb into an adjective: uvariť (to cook) → **uvarená** večera, a cooked dinner. It takes the endings you know: -ý, -á, -é.

Verbs in -ať and -ovať add **-aný** and **-ovaný**: upratať → uprataný, pozvať → pozvaný, rezervovať → rezervovaný. Verbs in -iť change it to **-ený**: uvariť → uvarený, kúpiť → kúpený. Upiecť gives upečený.
t: Narsa ustida biror ish bajarilganini aytish uchun slovak tili feʼlni sifatga aylantiradi: uvariť (pishirmoq) → **uvarená** večera, pishirilgan kechki ovqat. Bu oʻzbekchadagi -(i)lgan sifatdoshiga oʻxshaydi: pishir-ilgan. Qoʻshimchalari sizga tanish: -ý, -á, -é.

-ať va -ovať bilan tugaydigan feʼllar **-aný** va **-ovaný** oladi: upratať → uprataný, pozvať → pozvaný, rezervovať → rezervovaný. -iť bilan tugaydigan feʼllarda u **-ený** ga aylanadi: uvariť → uvarený, kúpiť → kúpený. Upiecť dan upečený hosil boʻladi.

en: The baked cake is on the table.
The wine we bought is in the kitchen.

a2-u9-l13.fill-na-stole-je.en.en: There's a freshly baked cake on the table.

a2-u9-l13.choice-uvarena-polievka.questi.en: Uvariť means to cook. Which one is a cooked soup?
a2-u9-l13.choice-uvarena-polievka.questi.t: Uvariť — pishirmoq. Qaysi biri pishirilgan shoʻrva?

a2-u9-l13.choice-uvarena-polievka.why.en: Verbs in -iť change it to **-ený**: uvariť → uvar**ená**, with -á for polievka.
a2-u9-l13.choice-uvarena-polievka.why.t: -iť bilan tugaydigan feʼllarda u **-ený** ga aylanadi: uvariť → uvar**ená**, polievka uchun -á bilan.

a2-u9-l13.fill-veronika-je-pozvana.why.en: Veronika is a woman: **pozvaná**. From pozvať: -ať → -aný.

en: Some short verbs end in **-tý** instead: umyť (to wash) → umytý, prestrieť (to lay the table) → prestretý, zohriať (to warm up) → zohriaty, naliať (to pour) → naliaty. After a long syllable like ia, the ending is short: -ty, -ta, -te.
Unlike the -úci words (hrajúce sa deti), these lose sa: zaľúbiť sa (to fall in love) → **zaľúbený**, najesť sa (to eat your fill) → **najedený**, osprchovať sa → osprchovaný.
t: Baʼzi qisqa feʼllar buning oʻrniga **-tý** bilan tugaydi: umyť (yuvmoq) → umytý, prestrieť (stol tuzamoq) → prestretý, zohriať (isitmoq) → zohriaty, naliať (quymoq) → naliaty. ia kabi choʻziq boʻgʻindan keyin qoʻshimcha qisqa boʻladi: -ty, -ta, -te.

-úci soʻzlaridan (hrajúce sa deti) farqli ravishda, bular sa ni tushirib qoldiradi: zaľúbiť sa (sevib qolmoq) → **zaľúbený**, najesť sa (toʻyib ovqatlanmoq) → **najedený**, osprchovať sa (dush qabul qilmoq) → osprchovaný.

a2-u9-l13.choice-stol-je-prestrety.quest.en: Lucia has laid the table. Which word fits? Stôl je ___.
a2-u9-l13.choice-stol-je-prestrety.quest.t: Lusiya stolni tuzadi. Qaysi soʻz mos keladi? Stôl je ___.

a2-u9-l13.choice-stol-je-prestrety.why.en: Prestrieť is one of the short verbs that end in **-tý**: prestre**tý**.
a2-u9-l13.choice-stol-je-prestrety.why.t: Prestrieť — **-tý** bilan tugaydigan qisqa feʼllardan biri: prestre**tý**.

a2-u9-l13.fill-riad-je-umyty.why.t: Riad (idish-tovoq) — erkak jinsidagi bitta soʻz, birlikda, shuning uchun **umytý**.

a2-u9-l13.choice-marek-je-zalubeny.quest.en: Marek is in love. How does Lucia say it?
a2-u9-l13.choice-marek-je-zalubeny.quest.t: Marek sevib qolgan. Lusiya buni qanday aytadi?

a2-u9-l13.choice-marek-je-zalubeny.why.en: Verbs with sa lose it in the participle: zaľúbiť sa → je **zaľúbený**.
a2-u9-l13.choice-marek-je-zalubeny.why.t: sa bilan keladigan feʼllar sifatdoshda uni yoʻqotadi: zaľúbiť sa → je **zaľúbený**.

en: These words change like pekný: -ý, -á, -é, and **-é** in the plural. Only men, or a group with men in it, take **-í**, like mladí kuchári: pozvaní hostia (invited guests).
t: Bu soʻzlar pekný kabi oʻzgaradi: -ý, -á, -é, koʻplikda esa **-é**. Faqat erkak kishilar yoki ichida erkak bor guruh mladí kuchári dagi kabi **-í** oladi: pozvaní hostia (taklif qilingan mehmonlar).

a2-u9-l13.fill-marek-a-veronika.en.en: Marek and Veronika have eaten their fill.

a2-u9-l14.grammar-byt-participle.title.en: Is it done? byť + the participle

en: To say something is done or ready, use byť and the participle. It agrees with its subject: Stôl **je** prestret**ý**. Sviečky **sú** zapálen**é**. In the past: Večera **bola** uvaren**á**.

Shops and phones use it a lot: obchod je zatvorený (closed) or otvorený (open), mobil je nabitý (charged) or vybitý (flat), zapnutý (on) or vypnutý (off), pokazený (broken: nefunguje, it doesn't work) or opravený (fixed).
Not done yet: nie je umytý, or before a noun as one word: neumytý riad.
t: Biror narsa bajarilgan yoki tayyor ekanini aytish uchun byť va sifatdosh ishlatiladi. Sifatdosh egaga moslashadi: Stôl **je** prestret**ý**. Sviečky **sú** zapálen**é**. Oʻtgan zamonda: Večera **bola** uvaren**á**.

Doʻkonlar va telefonlar haqida bu juda koʻp ishlatiladi: obchod je zatvorený (yopiq) yoki otvorený (ochiq), mobil je nabitý (quvvatlangan) yoki vybitý (quvvati tugagan), zapnutý (yoqilgan) yoki vypnutý (oʻchirilgan), pokazený (buzilgan: nefunguje, ishlamayapti) yoki opravený (tuzatilgan).
Hali bajarilmagan: nie je umytý, yoki ot oldida bitta soʻz qilib: neumytý riad.

en: Marek uvaril večeru. = Marek cooked the dinner. Večera je uvarená. = The dinner is cooked. The second sentence is about the dinner, and it doesn't say who did it: the object becomes the subject, and byť + the participle follows.
Notices use this a lot: predstavenie je zrušené (the show is cancelled), miesto je obsadené (the seat is taken).
t: Marek uvaril večeru. = Marek kechki ovqatni pishirdi. Večera je uvarená. = Kechki ovqat pishirilgan. Ikkinchi gap kechki ovqat haqida, unda kim qilgani aytilmaydi: toʻldiruvchi egaga aylanadi, keyin byť + sifatdosh keladi. Oʻzbekchadagi majhul nisbatga oʻxshaydi: pishirdi → pishirilgan.
Eʼlonlarda bu koʻp uchraydi: predstavenie je zrušené (tomosha bekor qilingan), miesto je obsadené (joy band).

a2-u9-l14.choice-marek-uvaril-veceru.why.en: The dinner becomes the subject, and the participle agrees with it: večera je uvaren**á**. Who did it is left out.
a2-u9-l14.choice-marek-uvaril-veceru.why.t: Kechki ovqat egaga aylanadi, sifatdosh unga moslashadi: večera je uvaren**á**. Kim qilgani tushirib qoldiriladi.

en: Bývať is byť for what usually happens. Obchod **je** zatvorený: it's closed now. V nedeľu **býva** zatvorený: it's usually closed on Sundays.

volať kabi tuslanadi: bývam, bývaš, býva… Uni «yashamoq» maʼnosida ham bilasiz: Bývam na internáte. = Yotoqxonada yashayman.

a2-u9-l16.grilovany.note.en: From **grilovať**: grilovaná ryba, grilované mäso. It works like the -aný words.

a2-u9-l17.fill-ano-vsimla-som.why.en: Veronika is a woman, so the past ends in **-la**: všim**la** som si, like stretnúť → stretla.

a2-u9-l17.chces-so-mnou.en.en: Will you go out with me?

a2-u9-l17.chces-so-mnou.note.en: **chodiť s** = to go out with, to date. Then she's his **priateľka** (girlfriend).
a2-u9-l17.chces-so-mnou.note.t: **chodiť s** = kim bilandir uchrashib yurmoq. Shundan keyin Veronika — uning **priateľka** (qiz doʻsti, sevgilisi).

en: Will you go out with me?
Will you go for a walk with me?
Will you come to the cinema with me?

a2-u9-l17.choice-chces-so-mnou.why.en: **Chodiť s niekým** means to go out with someone: to be a couple.
a2-u9-l17.choice-chces-so-mnou.why.t: **Chodiť s niekým** — kim bilandir uchrashib yurmoq, yaʼni juftlik boʻlmoq.

a2-u9-l17.podmienka.note.en: Mám jednu **podmienku**. = I've got one condition.

a2-u9-l17.fill-ano-ale-mam.en.en: Yes, but I've got one condition.

a2-u9-l17.fill-ano-ale-mam.why.en: The condition is the object of mám: -a → **-u**, podmienk**u**, just like jedna → jednu.
a2-u9-l17.fill-ano-ale-mam.why.t: Shart — mám ning toʻldiruvchisi: -a → **-u**, podmienk**u**, xuddi jedna → jednu kabi.

en: She cooks him dinner every Friday.
Marek cooks her dinner every Friday.
t: Har juma Veronika Marekka kechki ovqat tayyorlaydi.
Har juma Marek Veronikaga kechki ovqat tayyorlaydi.

a2-u9-l17.speak-zalubil-som-sa.en.en: I've fallen in love with you.

a2-u9-l18.priatelka.note.en: Veronika je Marekova **priateľka**. A friend you're not going out with is usually a kamarátka.
a2-u9-l18.priatelka.note.t: Veronika je Marekova **priateľka**. = Veronika — Marekning sevgilisi. Oddiy doʻst ayol odatda kamarátka deyiladi.

a2-u9-l18.myslela-som-ze.en.en: I thought I'd never live to see it!

a2-u9-l18.myslela-som-ze.note.en: **dožiť sa** = to live to see. Lucia laughs: her big brother has a girlfriend!
a2-u9-l18.myslela-som-ze.note.t: **dožiť sa** = (biror kunni) koʻrishga yetib bormoq. Lusiya kuladi: akasining sevgilisi bor!

a2-u9-l18.choice-marek-ma-priatelku.ques.en: How does Lucia take the news?
a2-u9-l18.choice-marek-ma-priatelku.ques.t: Lusiya bu xabarni qanday qabul qiladi?

a2-u9-l18.fill-veronika-je-velmi.why.en: Veronika is a woman, so the adjective ends in **-á**: šťastn**á**.
a2-u9-l18.fill-veronika-je-velmi.why.t: Veronika — ayol, shuning uchun sifat **-á** bilan tugaydi: šťastn**á**.

a2-u9-l18.zoznamit-sa.note.en: Kde ste sa **zoznámili**? = Where did you meet? Pán Kováč: So ženou sme sa zoznámili na **plese** (at a ball).
a2-u9-l18.zoznamit-sa.note.t: Kde ste sa **zoznámili**? = Qayerda tanishgansizlar? Janob Kovach: So ženou sme sa zoznámili na **plese** (balda). = Xotinim bilan balda tanishganmiz.

a2-u9-l18.choice-so-zenou-sme.question.en: Pán Kováč tells Emma about his wife. What does he say?
a2-u9-l18.choice-so-zenou-sme.question.t: Janob Kovach Emmaga xotini haqida gapirib beradi. U nima deydi?

en: He met his wife at a concert.
His wife is at a ball.
He met his wife at a ball.
“We” is my, so the past takes **-li**, with sme: zoznámi**li** sme sa.
“Where?” takes the locative after v: v **Bratislave**.
t: «Biz» — my, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon sme bilan **-li** oladi: zoznámi**li** sme sa.
v dan keyin «qayerda?» lokál talab qiladi: v **Bratislave** (Bratislavada).

a2-u9-l18.vziat-sa.note.en: O rok sme sa **vzali**. = We got married a year later. The wedding is the **svadba**.
a2-u9-l18.vziat-sa.note.t: O rok sme sa **vzali**. = Bir yildan keyin turmush qurdik. Toʻy — **svadba**.

a2-u9-l18.fill-o-rok-sme.en.en: We got married a year later.

a2-u9-l18.fill-o-rok-sme.why.en: We is my, so the past takes **-li**, with sme: vza**li** sme sa.
a2-u9-l18.fill-o-rok-sme.why.t: Biz — my, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon sme bilan **-li** oladi: vza**li** sme sa.

a2-u9-l18.build-kedy-bude-svadba.prompt.en: When's the wedding going to be?

en: Svadba is the subject here, so it stays **svadba**.
t: Svadba bu yerda ega, shuning uchun **svadba** boʻlib qoladi.

a2-u9-l18.iba-zartujem.note.en: **žart** = a joke. **Nehnevaj sa!** = Don't be cross!

a2-u9-l18.choice-nehnevaj-sa-iba.questio.en: Marek looks cross after Lucia's joke about a wedding. What does she say?
a2-u9-l18.choice-nehnevaj-sa-iba.questio.t: Lusiyaning toʻy haqidagi hazilidan keyin Marekning jahli chiqqanga oʻxshaydi. Lusiya nima deydi?

a2-u9-l18.choice-nehnevaj-sa-iba.why.en: Lucia talks about herself, ja: žartuje**m**. To her brother she says ty: **nehnevaj** sa.
a2-u9-l18.choice-nehnevaj-sa-iba.why.t: Lusiya oʻzi haqida gapiryapti, ja: žartuje**m**. Akasiga ty deydi: **nehnevaj** sa.

a2-u9-l18.rozist-sa.en.en: to split up, to break up

a2-u9-l18.rozist-sa.note.en: **hádať sa** = to argue. Rozišli sa. = They split up. Divorced: **rozvedený** (a man), **rozvedená** (a woman).
a2-u9-l18.rozist-sa.note.t: **hádať sa** = janjallashmoq. Rozišli sa. = Ular ajralishdi. Nikohdan ajrashgan: **rozvedený** (erkak), **rozvedená** (ayol).

a2-u9-l18.fill-casto-sa-hadali.en.en: They often argued, so they split up after a year.
a2-u9-l18.fill-casto-sa-hadali.en.t: Ular tez-tez janjallashardi, shuning uchun bir yildan keyin ajralishdi.

a2-u9-l18.fill-casto-sa-hadali.why.en: They were two people, oni, so the past ends in **-li**: sa roziš**li**. Rozišiel is one man, rozišla one woman.
a2-u9-l18.fill-casto-sa-hadali.why.t: Ular ikki kishi edi, oni, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-li** bilan tugaydi: sa roziš**li**. Rozišiel — bitta erkak, rozišla — bitta ayol.

a2-u9-l18.choice-laska-ide-cez.question.en: Lucia laughs about Marek's dinner. What does she mean?
a2-u9-l18.choice-laska-ide-cez.question.t: Lusiya Marekning kechki ovqati haqida kulib gapiradi. U nima demoqchi?

en: The way to someone's heart is through their stomach.

a2-u9-l18.speak-myslela-som-ze.en.en: I thought I'd never live to see it!

a2-u9-pisanie.listen-sarah-miluje-zviera.en: Sarah loves animals; she likes monkeys best.
a2-u9-pisanie.listen-sarah-miluje-zviera.t: Sara hayvonlarni yaxshi koʻradi, hammadan koʻra maymunlarni yoqtiradi.

a2-u9-pisanie.listen-v-zoo-su.en.en: There are two elephants and three lions at the zoo.
a2-u9-pisanie.listen-v-zoo-su.en.t: Hayvonot bogʻida ikkita fil va uchta sher bor.

a2-u9-pisanie.listen-listky-na-sobotu.en.en: The tickets for Saturday are sold out.

a2-u9-pisanie.listen-najprv-vymiesame-va.en: First we mix the eggs with the sugar.

a2-u9-pisanie.listen-stol-je-prestrety.e.en: The table is laid and dinner is cooked.

a2-u9-pisanie.listen-zalubil-som-sa.en.en: I fell in love with you at first sight.

a2-u9-pisanie.listen-marek-a-veronika.en.en: Marek and Veronika are going out together.

a2-u9-l19.fill-v-zoo-sme.en.en: We saw four tigers at the zoo.

a2-u9-l19.fill-v-zoo-sme.why.en: Two to four take the plural, and animal plurals work like things: štyri **tigre**. Tigrov comes after five.
a2-u9-l19.fill-v-zoo-sme.why.t: Ikkidan toʻrtgacha koʻplik keladi, hayvonlar koʻpligi esa narsalarniki kabi: štyri **tigre**. Tigrov beshdan keyin keladi.

a2-u9-l19.choice-predstavenie-v-sobotu.q.en: You hear this at the circus box office. What's the news?
a2-u9-l19.choice-predstavenie-v-sobotu.q.t: Buni sirk kassasida eshitasiz. Qanday yangilik?

en: There are still tickets for Saturday.
The Saturday show is sold out.

a2-u9-l19.fill-na-stole-je.en.en: There's a cooked dinner on the table.

a2-u9-l19.build-potrebujeme-dve-salky.pr.en: We need two cups of flour and five eggs.
a2-u9-l19.build-potrebujeme-dve-salky.pr.t: Bizga ikki chashka un va beshta tuxum kerak.

en: After a quantity, the of-form: dve šálky **múky**.
From five up, the of-form: päť **vajec**.

a2-u9-l19.choice-ktory-je-spiaci.questio.en: Which one is a lion that is asleep?

a2-u9-l19.choice-ktory-je-spiaci.why.en: Spať gives **spiaci**: who is sleeping. Spací is for things made for sleeping (spací vak), and lev is masculine, so -i.
a2-u9-l19.choice-ktory-je-spiaci.why.t: Spať dan **spiaci** hosil boʻladi: uxlayotgan. Spací uxlash uchun moʻljallangan narsalar uchun (spací vak), lev esa erkak jinsida, shuning uchun -i.

a2-u9-l19.fill-v-piatok-vecer.en.en: On Friday evenings restaurants are usually full.
a2-u9-l19.fill-v-piatok-vecer.en.t: Juma kechqurunlari restoranlar odatda toʻla boʻladi.

a2-u9-l19.build-nakoniec-ozdob-kolac.pro.en: Babka to Marek: Finally, decorate the cake with whipped cream.
a2-u9-l19.build-nakoniec-ozdob-kolac.pro.t: Buvi Marekka: Oxirida pirogni koʻpirtirilgan qaymoq bilan beza.

en: Babka says ty to Marek: **ozdob**. Ozdobte is for vy.
Whipped cream is what you decorate with: the instrumental, -a → **-ou**.
t: Buvi Marekka ty deydi: **ozdob**. Ozdobte vy uchun.
Koʻpirtirilgan qaymoq — bezash vositasi: inštrumentál («bilan» kelishigi), -a → **-ou**.

a2-u9-l19.choice-lucia-upratala-byt.ques.en: Lucia upratala byt. Which sentence is about the flat?
a2-u9-l19.choice-lucia-upratala-byt.ques.t: Lucia upratala byt. Qaysi gap kvartira haqida?

a2-u9-l19.choice-lucia-upratala-byt.why.en: The flat becomes the subject: byt **je** uprata**ný**, and who did it is left out.
a2-u9-l19.choice-lucia-upratala-byt.why.t: Kvartira egaga aylanadi: byt **je** uprata**ný**, kim qilgani esa tushirib qoldiriladi.

a2-u9-l19.fill-zalubila-som-sa.en.en: I've fallen in love with him.

a2-u9-l19.fill-zalubila-som-sa.why.en: Do takes the genitive, and after a preposition a pronoun takes its long form: do **neho**, like bez neho.
a2-u9-l19.fill-zalubila-som-sa.why.t: Do genitív talab qiladi, predlogdan keyin olmosh uzun shaklda keladi: do **neho**, bez neho kabi.

a2-u9-l19.choice-lucia-je-moja.question.en: Emma introduces Lucia. What does she say?
a2-u9-l19.choice-lucia-je-moja.question.t: Emma Lusiyani tanishtiradi. U nima deydi?

a2-u9-l19.choice-lucia-je-moja.why.en: Lucia is a woman: moja **spolubývajúca**, with -a.

en: I admit the circus without animals is better.
t: Tan olaman, hayvonlarsiz sirk yaxshiroq ekan.

a2-u9-l19.fill-klauni-zongluju-a.en.en: The clowns are juggling and the performer is dancing on the rope.
a2-u9-l19.fill-klauni-zongluju-a.en.t: Klounlar jonglyorlik qilyapti, artist ayol esa arqonda raqs tushyapti.

a2-u9-l19.fill-klauni-zongluju-a.why.en: Klauni are oni, so the verb ends in **-ú**: žongluj**ú**.
a2-u9-l19.fill-klauni-zongluju-a.why.t: Klauni — oni, shuning uchun feʼl **-ú** bilan tugaydi: žongluj**ú**.

a2-u9-l19.choice-pridem-neskor-to.questi.en: Veronika texts: Prídem neskôr. What does Marek answer?
a2-u9-l19.choice-pridem-neskor-to.questi.t: Veronika yozadi: Prídem neskôr. Marek nima deb javob beradi?
